summary: When a program crashes, Python prints a traceback. It tells you the file, the line number, and the type of error.
notes: Read the last line first: IndexError: list index out of range.
The File line gives the line number that crashed.
Lines before the crash still ran, so their output appears above the traceback.
pitfall: Fixing the line above or below the reported line. Go to the exact line number in the traceback first.
